name: VDL AI SEO
author: VaultDevLabs

sections.description:
VDL AI SEO helps you refresh existing WordPress content without leaving the editor. Use it to score a weak draft, see what is missing, generate a stronger version, and insert the improved copy back into the post.

For product details and setup help, visit the official VDL AI SEO page.

Use it for:

  • Refreshing older posts that need clearer structure
  • Scoring a draft before publishing
  • Finding missing headings, weak metadata, and content gaps
  • Generating an SEO-focused rewrite with insert-ready HTML
  • Creating a new outline when you are starting from scratch

The main workflow is:

  1. Open a post or page
  2. Run Analyze Draft to get a baseline score and fix list
  3. Run Optimize Content to generate an improved version
  4. Review the preview
  5. Insert or replace the content in the editor

The plugin can connect to an external AI service to return results and (optionally) track usage by license plan. Outline + Analyze are free. Includes 3 free content optimizations per month. Limits reset monthly. Unused optimizations do not roll over.

Works out-of-the-box

You can install and use the plugin immediately. If you configure an API key/license, the plugin can enable usage tracking and plan limits.

Honest SEO note

VDL AI SEO helps improve content structure, clarity, and on-page signals. It does not guarantee indexing, traffic, or rankings.

Privacy

When you run AI actions (outline / analyze / optimize), the plugin may send the relevant text and settings to the configured external AI service to generate results and track usage.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in WordPress: Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings → VDL AI SEO
  4. (Optional) Configure API / license settings
  5. Open a post or page and use the VDL AI SEO panel in the editor
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Not to install. To use AI actions via an external API you may need an API key and/or a license key depending on your setup.

Does this guarantee better rankings?

No. The plugin helps you improve on-page content quality and structure, but search rankings depend on many factors outside the plugin.

Does “Test Connection” use up my usage limit?

No. Test Connection is free.

What counts as usage?

Analyze Draft and Generate Outline are free. Optimize Content may consume usage units depending on your plan configuration. Includes 3 free content optimizations per month. Limits reset monthly. Unused optimizations do not roll over.

What data is sent to the API?

The text you submit for the requested action (outline topic, draft content, page content) plus relevant settings needed to generate results.

Where do I paste my license key?

Settings → VDL AI SEO.
